description: This file declares the interface for the Installation Manager component, including constants, macros, and function prototypes for managing application installations, their statuses, paths, and retries within a system.

methods.name: ImInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the installation manager with a maximum number of installations and an application-specific key.

methods.name: ImGetAppKey
methods.description: Retrieves the application key used by the installation manager.

methods.name: ImGetMaxNumberInstallations
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum number of installation slots available.

methods.name: ImUninitialize
methods.description: Uninitializes the installation manager, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: ImReset
methods.description: Resets the installation manager state, clearing all data.

methods.name: ImGetInstallationStatus
methods.description: Gets the status of a specific installation by index.

methods.name: ImGetInstallationNumTriesLeft
methods.description: Returns the number of remaining tries for a specific installation.

methods.name: ImDecrementInstallationNumTries
methods.description: Decrements the number of tries left for a specific installation.

methods.name: ImSelectNewInstallationIndex
methods.description: Selects a new installation index for upcoming installation.

methods.name: ImGetInstallationPath
methods.description: Gets the absolute path for a specific installation.

methods.name: ImMarkInstallationSuccessful
methods.description: Marks a specific installation as successful.

methods.name: ImRollForwardIfNeeded
methods.description: Rolls forward the installation if needed, making it current.

methods.name: ImRollForward
methods.description: Rolls forward to a specified installation index.

methods.name: ImRevertToSuccessfulInstallation
methods.description: Reverts to a previous successful installation.

methods.name: ImRequestRollForwardToInstallation
methods.description: Requests to roll forward to a specific installation index.
